config.enabled.name: Keep grass under things
config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the mod on or off. When off, your scythe cuts all grass as usual.
config.under-fences.name: Under fences and gates
config.under-fences.tooltip: Keep the grass under fences and gates.
config.under-objects.name: Under machines and objects
config.under-objects.tooltip: Keep the grass under placed objects like machines, chests, sprinklers, scarecrows or signs. Weeds, stones and forage don't count.
config.under-furniture.name: Under furniture
config.under-furniture.tooltip: Keep the grass under furniture placed outside, like benches or lamps.
config.all-weapons.name: Swords and other weapons too
config.all-weapons.tooltip: Also keep the grass when you swing a sword or dagger. When off, only scythes leave it alone.
